name: themes
description: Settings → Color theme (docs/color-themes.md). The free app: Classic is checked and the Pro themes show locked, with their 'Pro theme, locked' names (never tapped: that opens Google Play). The free app lists AMOLED Black and High Contrast locked too. CalcCraft Pro (and the open-source build): Night and then High Contrast can be picked, the calculator still reads its display under High Contrast, and Gold, Pro's default, is picked back.

steps.scroll_to: Gold, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
Night, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
Paper, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
AMOLED Black, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
High Contrast, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
